message.reasoning_content:
The bug: val_mask is a full-length boolean mask (8117) but Xt is the training subset (6493). In _train_one_model, val_mask is passed from the full dataset but Xt is built from training subset y. Need to fix. But we just report.

Also there are duplicate function definitions (run_predict, _save_bundle, _load_bundle, _prepare_fold) - later ones override. The first _save_bundle doesn't accept gbdt_models param but the second overrides, so okay. run_predict similarly overridden.

But the crash is the val_mask shape mismatch.
